## Publish gate report

**Going out:** About page copy for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No date was given.

**Checks run**
- **Claims:** one fails. See below.
- **Regulated claims:** nothing touches health, money, legal outcomes, the environment, children or prices. Pass.
- **House style:** short, plain and specific, with no AI tells or banned phrasing. Pass.
- **Disclosure:** this is owned about-page copy, with no ads, affiliates, gifted items or AI-generated content. Pass.

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | On the policy list |
| "small team of six" | Product fact (team size), fine as written |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | On the policy list |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unproven.** The policy backs only "4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website". A 98% five-star figure isn't sourced and doesn't match it. |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | Treated as an origins/sourcing fact, so allowed, but only if it's literally true |

**Fixed (suggested edit, not yet approved)**
- Replaced the 98% line with the policy-backed rating:

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. We're rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website, and we buy from gardens we've visited.

**Needs a decision**
1. If the 98% figure is real, someone needs to share the source (review platform, date range, method). It should then be added to the policy before it's used. Until then I suggest the 4.8 line.
2. Please confirm the team has actually visited the gardens they buy from. If only some of them, say "many of the gardens".

**Approver:** the policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact final wording above. I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should be published until you give it.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
```
